title: Catch 3 bugs ⭐
description: You must have all 3 bugs at the same time. The bugs do not have to be local in origin but you must have caught them in the neighborhood.

title: Solve a newspaper puzzle ⭐
description: Buy a physical newspaper and correctly solve a puzzle inside it. The paper must be bought inside the neighborhood in which you solve it.

title: Find and recreate a statue ⭐
description: Locate a statue without using the internet. One team member must hold the pose for at least 5 minutes.

title: Find chowder advertised
description: Find an advertisement for chowder that’s visible from outdoors. The advertisement must say the word “chowder” and/or have a picture that’s clearly chowder.

title: Attend a local event ⭐
description: This means a gathering of multiple people at an event that is open to the public. Timed public installations count.

title: Capture a politician on camera ⭐⭐
description: They may be elected or appointed. The picture must be clear enough that, given it and the politician’s official picture, a reasonable third party would agree they are the same person.

title: Visit a consulate or embassy
description: You may not use the internet to determine its location. You do not need to gain entry; a picture outside will suffice.

title: Walk a neighborhood’s border
description: Walk the entire length of two neighborhoods’ shared border. The border must be on land (it cannot be only through a bridge, tunnel, etc.). You do not need to walk exactly on the border; you may walk between the two endpoints any way you wish. If the border is split into multiple segments, you only need to walk one segment to claim the neighborhoods.

title: Predict STM doors
description: At any train or bus station, stand where you think the vehicle doors are going to land. You must be in position 20 seconds before the vehicle stops. You may only attempt this once per neighborhood.

title: Spend exactly $6.66 ⭐
description: This is based on the listed price, even if tax-exclusive. You may not tip, or pay more or less than the listed price.

title: Be Fast and Furious
description: Reach a speed of at least 20 kilometres per hour while angrily ranting about something you don’t like. This cannot be done while in/on a train, car, or bus.

title: Stalk a bird
description: You must have a single bird on camera continuously for five minutes. If you ever lose sight of the bird or have to cut, you must start over. The bird must be alive, and may not be caged.

title: Find a gun ⭐
description: Find and photograph a real gun. The gun cannot be a depiction of a gun. The gun must be an actual firearm.

title: Locate a Boston book
description: Find a physical copy of a book whose title names Boston, or one of the other cities/towns in this game.

title: Find a distant flag
description: It must be a country flag aside from that of Canada or the USA.

title: Cry
description: Produce any actual tear(s), using any means necessary.

title: Face snack
description: Place a snack of any kind on your forehead. Without using your hands, without help, and without the snack falling off your face, eat the snack. You may re-attempt as many times as you want.

title: Bribe the police
description: Visit any local police station and leave any amount of cash outside with a note outlining your (silly) demands. (You may take the money back after.)

title: Get a team mascot
description: Acquire any stuffed animal or figurine. Name it and keep it with you the rest of the game.

title: Spell your name in graffiti
description: Find all of the letters in one team member’s first name in already-written graffiti. The letters can, but do not need to, be from the same piece of graffiti. You may not make the graffiti yourself.

title: Predict market flow
description: Choose a store, and predict the amount of people that will enter the store within the next 10 minutes. The store must be open. Your prediction must be less than 40% off to complete the challenge. If your prediction is exactly correct, you earn a ⭐. You may only make one attempt per neighborhood.

title: Planespot ⭐
description: Photograph a plane on a trans-oceanic route. Use flightradar24 to verify.

title: Visit the water
description: Get within 1 metre of any body of water contiguous with the Atlantic Ocean.

title: Find an expensive car
description: The car must be worth at least 100,000 USD. It must be a real car, not a depiction. If it is worth at least 150,000 USD, you earn a ⭐.

title: Claim this neighborhood immediately, but… (Transit)
description: You may not board transit until you have visited 3 more neighborhoods.

title: Find identical addresses
description: Visit two places with identical addresses (same number and street name). If they are in separate unclaimed neighborhoods, claim both.

title: Atlas Obscura
description: Visit a location from atlasobscura.com. Spend at least 5 minutes there, and tell the opposing teams 3 fun facts about the place.

title: Find old money
description: Find a piece of money dated prior to 2000. It cannot be cash you possessed when this challenge was drawn. If the money is dated prior to 1980, you earn a ⭐.

title: Solve a riddle under a bridge ⭐
description: Get under a bridge, then visit TedEd's Riddles playlist and select a video at random. If anyone on the team is familiar with that riddle, select another video randomly. Once you hear the background information, pause and come up with an answer. You may only attempt one riddle per neighborhood.

title: Claim this neighborhood immediately, but… (Reveal)
description: Reveal your hand to the opposing teams. They may select one challenge; you must do that challenge next. (If you need to veto this, you may do so, but the neighborhood becomes unclaimed, and you must stay in one place for 30 minutes starting when you veto it.)

title: Visit every Dunkin in a neighborhood
description: There must be at least one. Earn a ⭐ per 4 Dunkins visited (round down).

title: Visit an island ⭐
description: Enter the Harbor Islands ‘neighborhood’, and claim it immediately. If it is already claimed, this card instead allows you to battle for it once there even without controlling enough adjacent neighborhoods.

title: Ride transit through a neighborhood ⭐
description: The vehicle you’re in cannot make any scheduled stops between entering and exiting the neighborhood.

title: Visit every train station in a neighborhood
description: This includes Commuter Rail, Trolley, and Train stations. There must be at least three stations within the neighborhood. You do not need to arrive at the stations via train. You do not need to visit any train station that will not receive service within the next week.

title: Enter every Star Market and Market Basket in a neighborhood
description: There must be at least one. Earn a ⭐ if you visit at least one of each.

title: Perfect timing
description: Find the current time represented somewhere permanent. (The display must not change every minute.) The time may be a 3- or 4- digit number with or without a colon or dash; 12-hour or 24-hour format are acceptable.

title: Race a bus
description: One teammate must race a bus at least one stop and win. The other teammate should ride the bus that distance. The race starts when doors open at the beginning stop, and ends when doors close at the ending stop.

title: Be a good citizen
description: Get a stranger to say “Thank you” to you. You may not indicate to them in any way that they are meant to do this.

title: Find Waldo ⭐
description: Find someone (not playing the game) wearing a red and white shirt. It may contain other colours as long as red and white are the two most common colours.

title: Photograph a big train ⭐
description: Photograph either an Amtrak train anywhere, or a Commuter Rail train outside a station.

title: Communicate via Semaphore ⭐
description: Using pre-designated arm signals, silently communicate a randomly generated 8-letter word to your opponent. You may use flags or other props, but are not required to. You may only attempt this challenge once per neighborhood.

title: Claim this neighborhood immediately, but… (Unclaim)
description: Unclaim a different neighborhood of your choosing.

title: Make a paper boat
description: The boat must be placed in water and float for at least 30 seconds.

title: Visit every college in a neighborhood
description: Colleges and Universities count. Earn a ⭐ per 3 visited (round down). To visit, you must touch one of its buildings. If a college is only partially within the neighborhood, you still must visit.

title: Quizmaster
description: Complete a randomly generated Sporcle quiz and score at least 55%. You may only attempt this once per neighborhood. If you score at least 85%, earn a ⭐.

title: Complete any 2 challenges of your choosing
description: Choose any two distinct challenges from the list and complete them. You do not get any ⭐s from this. These challenges may be repeats of others you have already done.

title: Find a farm animal ⭐⭐
description: Photograph a live cow, horse, sheep, goat, or pig.

title: End of the line
description: Ride a form of transit to its terminus. If you ride it from its other terminus and it starts and ends in different neighborhoods, claim both. (Otherwise, just claim the neighborhood the terminus is in.)

title: Play ball
description: Find any sports field and score a point against your teammate using a ball. You may find or create that ball, and any other infrastructure needed (goal, basket, etc).

title: Find an old grave
description: The grave must be at least 150 years old. If it is at least 250 years old, earn a ⭐.

title: Pretend to be rural
description: Walk 0.5 miles without crossing a street, and without retracing your steps. You must remain on marked paths and sidewalks.

title: Be a transit enthusiast
description: Be on 3 different transit lines within 20 minutes. The time starts when you disembark the first vehicle, and ends when you board the third. (You may count e.g. 34 and 34E, or GL-B and GL-C, as two separate lines, but inbound and outbound are the same line.)

title: Everything the light touches is our kingdom ⭐
description: Reach a non-water edge of the game map.

title: Find a house
description: Go to an ongoing open house. If the house is listed for over $1 million, earn a ⭐.

title: Be a traffic cop
description: Find a car that is parked illegally.

title: Use the library system
description: Check out a book from a library and return it to a different library. The libraries must be in some partnership such that the second can accept the return. If the libraries are in different neighborhoods, claim both.

title: Distant Photograph
description: One team member must take a picture of the other team member from a distance of at least half a mile away
